'''Ben Neluenf''' was the first great [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]-born [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. He lost his life attempting to scale a large mesa that was later named [[Ben's Mesa/Legends|Ben's Mesa]], as a tribute to him.

His son, [[Will Neluenf|Will]], who followed in his footsteps, participated in an illegal [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] on [[Euceron]] during the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]]. Will battled [[Hekula]], [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] son, and then 14-year-old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at the [[Great Dordon Caves]] during the [[Eusebus]]-based Games. He finished third among a lineup of contestants that included [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]], [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], [[Elan Mak]], and "Scorch" [[Zanales]].

Skywalker won the race on behalf of the children of [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]]—[[Deland Tyerell/Legends|Deland]] and [[Doby Tyerell|Doby]], whose podracer Anakin piloted to free their sister-slave [[Djulla]] from the clutches of her master, Sebulba.
